description: This Kotlin source file defines a class HorizontalSpaceItemDecoration that adds customizable horizontal spacing between items in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: HorizontalSpaceItemDecoration
classes.description: A RecyclerView.ItemDecoration that adds specified spacing between horizontally-scrolling items, including spacing at the edges.

methods.name: getItemOffsets
methods.description: Overrides the method to set the spacing (offsets) around each item in the RecyclerView, adding 'spacePx' pixels on the left of the first item, between items, and on the right of the last item.
